note: A NixOS option nixpkgs renamed: nixpkgs puts the notice in config.warnings (warning source 2), which the gate reads as data; abort-on-warn does not stop it.
exit_note: exit counts lint, build-test, coverage, facet-layers and laws as switched off (not built in this version); until the config can switch them off they are not-run and the exit of a passing fixture is 1.
